productBaseline.meaning: Canonical history through senior-review-approved CIV-34 publication; Gate D Evaluation 11 remains the first accepted PASS; Evaluations 01 through 10 remain immutable historical FAIL evidence; Blockers 01 through 10 remain fixed and published; Gate D and CIV-34 are published; CIV-35 is the next eligible phase.

validationBaseline.scope: Published V4-MILESTONE-RENEWABLE-SUBSISTENCE-v1 evidence implemented from the published CIV-33 canonical baseline; the containing publication commit is intentionally identified by Git rather than self-referenced.

civ34Validation.scope: Published CIV-34 Production Tools and Workshops V1 result; the containing publication commit is intentionally identified by Git rather than self-referenced.
